sources: Ghana and Norway jointly led work on the Gulf of Guinea piracy draft. Ghana said the compromise preserved agreed language on the law of the sea convention and clarified the text's geographic reach. Ghana is listed among those voting in favour when the Council adopted resolution 2634 (2022) unanimously.

China supported the purpose of the Gulf of Guinea piracy draft but cautioned that the law of the sea convention does not govern every maritime issue. China is listed among those voting in favour when the Council adopted resolution 2634 (2022) unanimously.
proposals: Both delegations voted in favour of resolution 2634 (2022).
Both delegations said the law of the sea convention regulates every maritime issue.
said the law of the sea convention regulates every maritime issue

sources: The United Kingdom submitted the draft and welcomed the Council's one-year renewal of the UN mission in Libya. It urged Libyan parties to engage with the UN road map towards inclusive elections. The roll call records a yes vote from the United Kingdom on resolution 2796 (2025).

Algeria explained the A3+ vote in favour of the renewal of the UN mission in Libya as continued support for the mission. Speaking for the group, Algeria also reiterated a call for all foreign forces, foreign fighters and mercenaries to leave Libya immediately. The roll call puts Algeria among the 15 members voting yes on resolution 2796 (2025).
proposals: Both delegations voted in favour of resolution 2796 (2025).
Both delegations called for immediate withdrawal of all foreign forces from Libya.
called for immediate withdrawal of all foreign forces from Libya
